subject: Pre-demo checklist + finding a time that works
content:
From: Thomas Li <thomas.li@fastcart.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Quick demo request + a few details

Hi Monica,

Thanks for the quick signup flow — excited to learn more about Redwood. We run personalization and product search for FastCart and are evaluating hosted inference for generative product descriptions and conversational assistance.

Quick context:
- Monthly active users: ~1.2M, peak concurrent search sessions ~5k/day.
- Typical response sizes: 50–150 tokens.
- Timeline: aiming to have a pilot ready in Q1 '27 and production by end of Q2.

Would like a 30–45 minute demo to see latency/cost tradeoffs and your rollout knobs. I attached a very small traffic snapshot. Also interested whether you have a managed plan for procurement / SLA for >500k monthly tokens.

Best,
Thomas
Thomas Li
Head of ML Eng, FastCart
Attachment: FastCart_traffic_estimate.xlsx (spreadsheet)

-----Original Message-----

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Thomas Li <thomas.li@fastcart.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 09:25:40 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick demo request + a few details

Hi Thomas — thanks for the details and the file. Happy to run through use cases and show some concrete latency / cost numbers.

Couple quick questions so the demo is targeted:
- Main objective: reduce generation cost per description, or improve perceived search relevance (or both)?
- Peak concurrency: is 5k/day peak concurrent sessions or peak searches per day?
- Data residency / privacy needs? Is FastCart comfortable with hosted inference or would you prefer private deployment options?

I’m looping in Dylan (SDR) to help lock a time. Are you available Friday 11/13 between 10:00–11:30am PT or Monday 11/16 2:00–4:00pm PT? If those don’t work, send a few times and we’ll accommodate.

Also: we can attach a standard SOW template and an enterprise pricing snapshot after the demo — would that help procurement?

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>

-----On Thu, Nov 12, 2026 at 10:12 AM Thomas Li <thomas.li@fastcart.com> wrote:-----
From: Thomas Li <thomas.li@fastcart.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 10:12:05 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick demo request + a few details

Hi Monica — quick answers below:
- Objective: both — primary is to improve description quality and consistency across categories, secondary is to lower unit inference costs versus our current baseline.
- 5k/day is peak searches per day (not concurrent). Typical spikes during promotions can be 1.5–2x.
- Data residency: US-first; we may need EU controls later. For now hosted API is fine but keen to understand Private options.

Friday 11/13 at 10:30am PT works for me.
One question — do you have a ballpark for per-token pricing tier for evaluation volumes (500k–1.5M tokens/month)? Procurement will want a range before we schedule internal stakeholders.

Thanks,
Thomas

-----On Thu, Nov 12, 2026 at 10:45 AM Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com> wrote:-----
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Thomas Li <thomas.li@fastcart.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 10:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick demo request + a few details

Perfect — locking 11/13 10:30am PT for a 45-minute call. Sending an invite shortly (calendar link below).

High-level pricing guidance for eval volumes: for proof-of-concept (500k–1.5M tokens/mo) we typically see hosted API effective unit costs in the $0.0007–$0.0012 per generated token range depending on batching and model selection. For pilots that require higher throughput or Private deployment, we can surface Dedicated pricing and a procurement path during/after the demo. I’ll follow up with a pricing sheet after the call.

Pre-demo checklist (short):
- Can you share a small set of prompt examples you want to test (5–10)?
- Confirm peak search spikes and any sync windows for bulk generation.
- Any compliance constraints (PII, retention limits)?

I attached our standard SOW template for your procurement team to scan.

Calendar invite: https://redwood.app/scheduler/slot/monica-abc123
Attachment: SOW_template.pdf (PDF)

Thanks,
Monica

-----On Fri, Nov 13, 2026 at 10:21 AM Thomas Li <thomas.li@fastcart.com> wrote:-----
From: Thomas Li <thomas.li@fastcart.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 10:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick demo request + a few details

Monica — sorry for the late note. An exec on our side needs to move the call to 11/16; can we push the demo to Monday 11/16 at 2:30pm PT instead? That time you suggested earlier should work.

If that works I’ll send a new invite.

Appreciate it,
Thomas

-----End of thread-----
